_description: Starter pack of canonical show commands for EVPN VPLS Seamless Integration (SI) tests. Sourced from the DV HLD + epic SW-178648 + datapath enabler SW-183400. Any new test targeting EVPN VPLS SI starts with this set; commands are validated against a live device the first time they run and cached forever in the shared tier.
confluence_anchors: EVPN (ELAN) Seamless integration with VPLS (BGP) - HLD
EVPN (ELAN) Seamless integration with VPLS (BGP) - MAC and MAC-IP Handling Design

show_commands.purpose: Top-level EVPN state summary; first sanity check.
Per-instance state including VPLS PW counters, AC list, MAC counts.
Verify which interface/PW each MAC was learned on.
Per-PW state, label, peer, last move.
PW-level packet/byte counters, plus error counters.
Datapath MAC table view (vs control-plane mac-table above).
BGP routes carrying VPLS NLRI for this peer set.
BGP EVPN session state -- both peers must be Established.
Confirm VPLS / EVPN label-pool carving (see SW-253359 known bug).
Read the running config for the EVI/BD under test.

commands: show file traces routing_engine/bgpd_traces | include 'l2vpn vpls'
show file ncp 0 traces datapath/wb_agent.evpn | include <HH:MM>
show file ncp 0 traces datapath/wb_agent.l2 | include <HH:MM>

known_gotchas: BD instance name is NOT the VLAN ID. Use show interfaces or show config interfaces <port>.<subif> for the actual vlan-id.
EVPN MAC table shows source-qualified entries: 'Local'/'L>' for AC-learned, 'v>' for PW-learned. Always assert against the source qualifier.
After bgpd restart with LLGR enabled, evpn-vpws single-homed AC may incorrectly enter blocking-all (SW-248517).
bgp-vpls-label-block-size committed AFTER cluster boot may permanently fail to carve labels (SW-253359 -- no operational fix).
